senses.definition: (countable) A blow, especially one given with the open hand, or with something broad and flat.
examples: He gave me a friendly slap on the back as a sign of camaraderie.

senses.definition: (countable) A sharp percussive sound like that produced by such a blow.
examples: the slap of my feet on the bathroom tiles

senses.definition: (countable, music) The percussive sound produced in slap bass playing.

senses.definition: (transitive) To strike someone, typically with an open hand, often on the face.
examples: She slapped him in response to the insult.

senses.definition: (transitive) To cause something to strike soundly.
examples: He slapped the reins against the horse's back.
The rain slapped against the window-panes.

quotes.text: Mrs. Flanders rose, slapped her coat this side and that to get the sand off, and picked up her black parasol.
